objectives.description: Recognize visible body features and indicate a minimal pain location, while adjudicating the detailed anatomy boundary.
objectives.rationale: Immediate identification and help need a small concrete core; detailed anatomical contrasts are explicitly proposed later.

objectives.description: Identify someone by height, build, hair and visible accessories.
objectives.rationale: Select neutral observable contrasts and do not convert appearance into health or moral judgments.

objectives.description: Understand a short instruction or description of basic bodily movement.
objectives.rationale: Separate useful immediate actions from expanded routine and movement contrasts.

objectives.description: Give a brief description of a person's ordinary social manner.
objectives.rationale: Concrete interpersonal adjectives support an introduction without clinical labels.

objectives.description: Identify a simple emotional state and account for later contextual explanations.
frameworkSections: 9.2.2 feelings; 5.3 expressing tastes, desires and feelings
objectives.rationale: Basic responses are separate from narrating causes or analyzing mental states.

objectives.description: State an immediate need for food, drink, rest or comfortable temperature.
objectives.rationale: Wordfold proposes limited immediate-needs A1 extensions where the thematic PCIC list uses A2; this requires explicit adjudication.

objectives.description: Link basic communication with later remembering, thinking and belief vocabulary.
frameworkSections: 9.2.4 unpopulated A1/A2 subsection; 8.7.1 reflection and knowledge
objectives.rationale: Mental-activity meanings are coordinated with F and D; later introduction recommendations do not change runtime levels.

objectives.description: Give one's name, origin, language and status in a short introduction.
objectives.rationale: Identify personal information without teaching immigration procedure or unlimited nationality lists.

objectives.description: Provide a residential address and contact details.
objectives.rationale: Reuse geographic, numeric and communication senses through crosslinks.

objectives.description: Identify age and adult/child relationships while bounding life-event vocabulary.
frameworkSections: 9.1.4 life cycle; 9.3.1.4 birth; 9.3.1.6 age; 9.3.1.7 person reference
objectives.rationale: A1 age/form labels do not require birth/death narratives or reproductive technical vocabulary.

objectives.description: Describe marital status and a partner relationship without presuming family structure.
objectives.rationale: Include respectful status contrasts and spouse/partner distinctions, not procedures for changing status.

objectives.description: Recognize and complete elementary identity-document fields.
objectives.rationale: Name, signature and document recognition are bounded immediate tasks; rules about document validity are excluded.

objectives.description: Identify essential personal belongings.
objectives.rationale: Possession uses reuse existing objects; useful missing accessories are selected without copying an exhaustive product catalog.

objectives.description: Describe a bounded close-family tree and identify each relationship.
objectives.rationale: Parents, children, siblings, grandparents, grandchildren, aunts/uncles, cousins and nieces/nephews bound this version's first family network.

objectives.description: Introduce a friend or contact and identify the kind of social relationship.
objectives.rationale: Work-specific relations link to W, social actions to D; later relational abstraction is not an A1 prerequisite.

objectives.description: Identify a party or birthday and recognize the basic occasion in a short invitation.
objectives.rationale: Naming an occasion is separated from narrating ceremonies and detailed religious/social customs.

objectives.description: Ask for basic assistance and identify a person or service able to help.
objectives.rationale: Immediate help is a bounded communicative use; service logistics and longer requests remain linked to T and D.

objectives.description: Say one is ill or in pain and account for named symptoms introduced later.
objectives.rationale: A1 illness/help statements must not imply medical diagnosis or detailed symptom competence.

objectives.description: Recognize a doctor, nurse and healthcare facility.
objectives.rationale: The task is identifying care access, not describing a healthcare system.

objectives.description: Recognize pharmacy/medicine references and defer treatment-specific descriptions.
objectives.rationale: Medicinal products are lexical labels only; no dosage, diagnosis, therapeutic promise or self-treatment instruction.

objectives.description: Describe elementary washing routines and identify basic hygiene products.
objectives.rationale: Washing actions are distinct from the later inventory of specialist grooming products.

objectives.description: Preserve legacy place/nutrition senses mistakenly filed under person topics.
objectives.rationale: The existing quiet-place tranquilo and health-promoting sano meanings must not be overwritten with person-state meanings.

objectives.description: Reuse core liking and wanting predicates without creating extra person-topic copies.
objectives.rationale: Core predicate ownership belongs to F/D; P supplies social context and preserves the original selected meanings.

objectives.description: Explain reproduction or narrate birth, development and death.
objectives.rationale: Outside the A1 immediate introduction scope: age and birth-form labels are selected, while nacer is explicitly proposed A2. Detailed reproductive, developmental and bereavement narratives belong to later P batches.

objectives.description: Analyze psychological states or patterns of conduct.
objectives.rationale: Everyday feeling labels already receive dispositions; psychological explanation, diagnoses and conduct analysis are not hidden A1 prerequisites.

objectives.description: Evaluate personal values in a nuanced relationship.
objectives.rationale: A1 names observable social manner; fine ethical evaluation and qualified judgments belong to later P/D. This exclusion does not remove legacy amable or other concrete traits.

objectives.description: Describe injuries, trauma mechanisms or treatment.
objectives.rationale: A1 help and pain location are explicitly handled; detailed injury classification is not required for those short exchanges.

objectives.description: Use calendar, number, article, person-reference and question paradigms in introductions.
frameworkSections: 8.2 quantitative notions; 8.4 temporal notions; 9.3 personal data
objectives.rationale: Same-level F dependency, unresolved until A1-F acceptance: full bounded number/date paradigms, age/need tener constructions, interrogatives and reference forms. P crosslinks particular meanings, not every calendar label or integer.

objectives.description: Open, close, ask clarification and make a basic request in a people/health exchange.
frameworkSections: 5.1 information; 5.4 influencing the interlocutor; 5.5 social relations
objectives.rationale: Same-level D dependency, unresolved until A1-D acceptance: greeting/thanks/apology formulas are crosslinked; requests, clarification, intonation and address choice must be composed and reviewed there.
